# Load metrics
```{r}
metrics <- read.csv("/data/akalin/akollot/anglemania_benchmark/Luecken_Theis_NatMethods_2021/metrics/combined_metrics.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
head(metrics)
colnames(metrics)
samplesheet <- read.csv("/local/Projects/AAkalin_Neuroblastoma/data/Luecken_Theis_NatMethods_2021_benchmarking/samplesheet.tsv", sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


metrics <- metrics %>%
  left_join(samplesheet, by = join_by(sample == sample_name))

# metrics["Batch"] = metrics[["ASW_label/batch", "PCR_batch", "graph_conn"]].mean(axis=1)
# metrics["Bio"] = metrics[["ASW_label", "isolated_label_silhouette"]].mean(axis=1)
bio_metrics <- c("cLISI", "ARI_cluster.label", "NMI_cluster.label", "ASW_label", "isolated_label_F1", "isolated_label_silhouette")
batch_metrics <- c("kBET", "ASW_label.batch", "iLISI")

# calculate weighted mean with 0.6 for bio and 0.4 for batch
# first min max scale every metrics
#metrics_scaled = (metrics - metrics.min()) / (metrics.max() - metrics.min())
min_max_norm <- function(x) {
    (x - min(x)) / (max(x) - min(x))
  }

metrics_scaled <- metrics %>%
  # scale data
  # mutate(across(all_of(bio_metrics), ~ min_max_norm(.) %>% as.vector), .by = c(integration_method, sample)) %>%
  # mutate(across(all_of(batch_metrics), ~ min_max_norm(.) %>% as.vector), .by = c(integration_method, sample)) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    bio_score = mean(c_across(all_of(bio_metrics))),
    batch_score = mean(c_across(all_of(batch_metrics))),
    overall_score = 0.6 * bio_score + 0.4 * batch_score
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

View(metrics_scaled)
colnames(metrics_scaled)
```


```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = as.factor(gene_selection), y = overall_score))+
  geom_point(aes(color = gene_selection), size = 6)+
  facet_wrap(~integration_method+sample, ncol = 6)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
p
```

```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.7)

p <- metrics_scaled %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = bio_score, y = batch_score))+
  geom_point(aes(color = gene_selection), size = 6)+
  facet_wrap(~integration_method+sample, ncol = 6)
p
```
